edges.reason: Addition within ten includes the sums within five. Only the overlapping addition facts are necessary, not a prior course-completion claim.
Interpreting sums with values six through ten requires those number and quantity meanings.
Decomposing and recomposing a multi-digit number uses the value of each digit's decimal place.
Column addition reinforces place-value alignment and regrouping. Mental hundreds/tens sums can be obtained by decomposition and unit counts without laying out written columns.
Mental arithmetic on hundreds and tens uses the values of those places in three-digit numbers.
